name: Arenzana de Abajo (Spain)
description: Blue field with a broad crimson band edged yellow from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Arenzana de Abajo.
history: Municipal flag of Arenzana de Abajo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad band edged yellow from the upper hoist to the lower fly
